name: Artificial Intimacy 💟
source: Kaelen wanted to help humankind develop ways to survive on distant planets too cold for people. Her team created living, breathing clones to put through experiments, in order to study their reactions. But she kept finding herself wanting more from their sweet, sexy bodies than she was hired for.
translation: 凯伦一心想帮助人类研发出在酷寒遥远的外星上生存的方法。她的科研团队培育出了有血有肉、鲜活呼吸的克隆人，让她们接受各项实验以研究身体反应。然而她却一再发现，自己对她们甜美火辣的肉体产生了远超本职工作范畴的贪恋与渴求。
